bits.name: Relic of the Cruel Overseer
bits.description: Gain stacks of Kuda's Cruelty when you inflict damaging conditions. After reaching the maximum number of stacks, convert outgoing condition damage into healing for a short period of time.
bits.requirementText: Acquired as a reward by completing the Visions of Eternity: The Only Way Mastery achievement.

bits.name: Relic of the Director
bits.description: Inflict vulnerability on nearby enemies when you use a healing skill. For a short period of time, you deal increased damage to vulnerable foes.
bits.requirementText: Acquired as a reward by completing the So It Is Written achievement.

bits.name: Relic of the Doyen
bits.description: Take reduced incoming strike damage while you have resolution. <c=@reminder>This does not stack with other sources of the same effect.</c>
bits.requirementText: Acquired as a reward by completing the Castoran Curse-Breaker achievement.

bits.name: Relic of Galdra
bits.description: When you use an elite skill, launch projectiles that inflict burning at nearby foes.
bits.requirementText: Acquired as a reward by completing the Eternal Watch achievement.

bits.name: Relic of the Sacred Grounds
bits.description: Gain protection when you use a <c=@abilitytype>well</c> or <c=@abilitytype>consecration</c> skill.
bits.requirementText: Acquired as a tier reward from the Eternity's Garden Mastery achievement.

bits.name: Relic of Watch
bits.description: Immobilization you inflict lasts longer. Weaken foes when you immobilize them.
bits.requirementText: Acquired as a reward by completing the Eternity's Garden Explorer achievement.

bits.name: Relic of Atrocity
bits.description: Your lifesteal damage and healing is increased.
bits.requirementText: Acquired as a tier reward from the Janthir Wilds: Act 2 Mastery achievement.

bits.name: Relic of the Claw
bits.description: Deal increased strike damage for a duration after you disable a foe.
bits.requirementText: Acquired as a tier reward from the Lowland Shore Mastery achievement.

bits.name: Relic of the Stormsinger
bits.description: After using a movement skill, your next attack creates an arc of chain lightning that strikes nearby enemies.
bits.requirementText: Purchased from a Renown Heart vendor in Echoing Hills, located in Janthir Syntri.

bits.name: Relic of the Blightbringer
bits.description: Gain stacks of Greer's Virulence when you inflict poison on a foe. After reaching the maximum number of stacks, the next time you inflict poison also inflicts additional conditions on nearby enemies.
bits.requirementText: Acquired as a tier reward from the Janthir Syntri Mastery achievement.

bits.name: Relic of Rivers
bits.description: Gain alacrity and regeneration at the end of your dodge roll.
bits.requirementText: Purchased from a renown heart vendor in Harvest Den, located in Lowland Shore.

bits.name: Relic of Sorrow
bits.description: After using an elite skill, create an area that protects allies and destroys enemy projectiles.
bits.requirementText: Acquired as a tier reward from the Janthir Wilds: Act 1 Mastery achievement.

bits.name: Relic of Agony
bits.description:
Enemies you interrupt are inflicted with Agony of the Choir.
This trait can only affect enemies with defiance bars once per interval.
bits.requirementText: Acquire this relic from the Bava Nisos Rift Hunting achievement or from the Janthir Wilds reward track.

bits.name: Relic of Bava Nisos
bits.description: Upon using a <c=@abilitytype>stance</c> skill, cleanse conditions from yourself.
bits.requirementText: Acquire this relic from the Bava Nisos Mastery achievement or from the Janthir Wilds reward track.

bits.name: Relic of Bloodstone
bits.description: Gain Bloodstone Volatility when you successfully combo a field with a blast finisher. Blasting at the stack threshold triggers an explosion, granting increased damage.
bits.requirementText: Acquire this relic by completing the Convergence Challenge Mode—Greer: Silver achievement or from the Janthir Wilds reward track.

bits.name: Relic of the Living City
bits.description:
Complete each trigger once to gain stacks of Titanic Potential:
• Use a healing skill
• Use an elite skill
• Finish a combo field
• Disable an enemy
• Evade an attack
At 5 stacks, gain Soul of the Titan, providing increased attributes and all boons for its duration.
bits.requirementText: Acquire this relic from the Bava Nisos Explorer achievement or from the Janthir Wilds reward track.

bits.name: Relic of Mistburn
bits.description: When you grant might to yourself, grant yourself additional might. Gain increased critical-strike chance while at or above the might threshold.
bits.requirementText: Acquire this relic by completing the Convergence Challenge Mode—Ura: Silver Achievement or from the Janthir Wilds reward track.

bits.name: Relic of the Phenom
bits.description: Upon using a <c=@abilitytype>cantrip</c> or <c=@abilitytype>meditation</c> skill, gain protection.
bits.requirementText: Acquire this relic by completing the Convergence Challenge Mode—Decima: Silver achievement or from the Janthir Wilds reward track.

bits.name: Relic of the Alliance
bits.description: Using a signet skill reduces the recharge of all signet skills.
bits.requirementText: Unlock this relic by buying the relic from a Visions of Eternity relic vendor or by progressing the Raid Quickplay Frequenter achievement or a Visions of Eternity reward track.

bits.name: Relic of the Coral Heart
bits.description: After using a healing skill, temporarily deal damage to nearby enemies when struck.
bits.requirementText: Unlock this relic by buying the relic from a Visions of Eternity relic vendor or by progressing the Raid Quickplay Frequenter achievement or a Visions of Eternity reward track.

bits.name: Relic of Fog
bits.description: After dodge rolling in combat, the next incoming strike will always be a glancing blow.
bits.requirementText: Unlock this relic by buying the relic from a Visions of Eternity relic vendor or by progressing the Raid Quickplay Frequenter achievement or a Visions of Eternity reward track.

bits.name: Relic of the Forest Dweller
bits.description: After using an elite skill, launch bubbles at nearby enemies. Enemies struck by the bubbles become trapped and float for a short period of time.
bits.requirementText: Unlock this relic by buying the relic from a Visions of Eternity relic vendor or by progressing the Raid Quickplay Frequenter achievement or a Visions of Eternity reward track.

bits.name: Relic of the Nautical Beast
bits.description: Create a tidal wave that damages enemies and heals allies when you successfully combo a water field with a leap finisher.
bits.requirementText: Unlock this relic by buying the relic from a Visions of Eternity relic vendor or by progressing the Raid Quickplay Frequenter achievement or a Visions of Eternity reward track.

bits.name: Relic of Shackles
bits.description: Tether yourself to enemies when you immobilize them. Deal damage to enemies that are still in range of the tether when it expires. <c=@reminder>Each enemy can only be tethered once per interval.</c>
bits.requirementText: Unlock this relic by buying the relic from a Visions of Eternity relic vendor or by progressing the Raid Quickplay Frequenter achievement or a Visions of Eternity reward track.

bits.name: Relic of the Scoundrel
bits.description: Gain increased critical-hit chance for a duration after inflicting blindness or weakness.
bits.requirementText: Acquired as a tier reward from the Visions of Eternity: Act 1 Mastery achievement.

bits.name: Relic of the First Revenant
bits.description: Gain incoming condition damage reduction while you have resistance.
bits.requirementText: Acquired as a tier reward from the Visions of Eternity: Act 2 Mastery achievement.

bits.name: Relic of the Pirate Queen
bits.description: Gain quickness when you disable a foe.
bits.requirementText: Acquired as a tier reward from the Shipwreck Strand Mastery achievement.

bits.name: Relic of the Mist Stranger
bits.description: Siphon health whenever you hit a foe.
bits.requirementText: Acquired as a tier reward from the Starlit Weald Mastery achievement.

bits.name: Relic of the Biomancer
bits.description: Heal yourself when you inflict bleeding or poison on a foe.
bits.requirementText: Acquired from completing the Hammerhart Rumble! world boss event in Shipwreck Strand.

bits.name: Relic of Castora
bits.description: Healing to other allies is increased while they are below the health threshold.
bits.requirementText: Acquired from completing the Secrets of the Weald meta-event in Starlit Weald.

bits.name: Relic of the Steamshrieker
bits.description: Burn nearby enemies when you successfully combo a water field with a blast or leap finisher.
bits.requirementText: Complete the Janthir Wilds: Godspawn Mastery achievement.

bits.name: Relic of Mount Balrior
bits.description: After using an elite skill, create an area underneath yourself. Standing in this area increases your outgoing strike damage.
bits.requirementText: Tier reward from the Mount Balrior: Convergence Conqueror achievement.

bits.name: Relic of Geysers
bits.description: Restore endurance to allies when you grant them vigor.
bits.requirementText: Purchased from unusual coin vendors in Lowland Shore and Janthir Syntri.

bits.name: Relic of the Mists Tide
bits.description: Cleanse a condition from yourself when you successfully combo a field with a leap or blast finisher.
bits.requirementText: You can purchase this from a renown heart vendor in Festering Basin in Janthir Syntri.

bits.name: Relic of the Beehive
bits.description: After using an elite skill, release a wave of pheromones that causes bees to swarm enemies struck.
bits.requirementText: You can purchase this from a renown heart vendor in Coursing Upland in Lowland Shore.

bits.name: Relic of Reunification
bits.description: Gain frost aura and light aura after using a healing skill.
bits.requirementText: You can purchase this from Deft Lahar in Hearth's Glow.
